pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark brown contiguous regions exhibit a highly irregular, jagged-edged geometry with multiple dendritic projections. Pixel gradients at the margins are sharp, transitioning abruptly to the lighter interstitial color. Patch area is heterogeneous, with larger, more elongated shapes positioned dorsally and smaller, more complex polygons appearing on the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-toned interstitial space forms a continuous, interconnected network of pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial. The pixel thickness of these corridors is non-uniform, displaying thinning at high-angle junctions and widening in the lateral mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck shows a distinct, reddish-brown silhouette with a consistent, high-frequency serrated edge. The amplitude of individual hair tufts is relatively uniform across the visible upper neck profile.
